cap: Hormonal vasodilation and the placental circuit lower systemic vascular resistance, so blood pressure falls to a nadir in the second trimester. The kidney reads this as underfilling and activates renin, angiotensin and aldosterone, which expand plasma volume; the larger preload raises stroke volume, then heart rate, and cardiac output rises 40 to 50 percent. Supine after 20 weeks, the uterus compresses the inferior vena cava and preload falls.
